description: Plans: pay crypto. WHEN: you already have a PENDING_PAYMENT order from plan_checkout and you sent the exact USDC amount on Base to the recipient shown. Submit {order_code, tx_hash}. We fetch the receipt once (no chain watching), check Circle USDC → our wallet ≥ exact amount with enough confirmations, then activate the same way as X Money reconcile. Idempotent per tx_hash. Requires CRYPTO_PAY_ENABLED and checkout_live. Registered key required. Solana not available yet. Example: plan_pay_crypto {"order_code":"<order_code>","tx_hash":"<tx_hash>"}

key.description: Your ark_ key (or send Authorization: Bearer <key>). Registered keys only.

tx_hash.description: Base transaction hash (0x…64 hex) of your USDC transfer.
